data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net calendar year claims incurred of $124,103,000 (2023: $106,371,000) is a deterioration of $9,063,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end (2023: deterioration $10,197,000).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2024 were $419.12m. During 2024 management increased prior-year gross claims provisions by $15.642m (a 3.73% strengthening of opening reserves), reflecting adverse development across prior periods and additional IBNR/inflationary loadings; after reinsurance the net deterioration reported was $9.063m. No single large named event is identified as the driver; the movement is explained as general adverse claims development and reserve margin/IBNR adjustments.
raw_causal_phrases: a deterioration of $9,063,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end (2023: deterioration $10,197,000).
we have therefore made a provision within claims that have been incurred at the reporting date but have not yet been reported ("IBNR") in the calendar year to allow for this reserving uncertainty.

the assumptions underlying our reserving methodology reflect additional information obtained from pricing current and prospective business. The implications of this analysis have been incorporated into our reserving approach for all years of account which includes a loading for inflation and a margin added over and above actuarial best estimates set with reference to the margin policy.
data.data_quality_notes: All amounts are reported in the syndicate's presentation currency (USD). Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding, prior year column). Prior year movement (gross) taken from note 18 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' = $15,642k (15.642m). Exact_reserve_text copies the document sentence which reports the NET deterioration of $9,063k (after reinsurance) - gross and net figures are both present in note 18. No per-line-of-business reserve movements are quantified in the notes, so LOB-specific amounts are null. Claims development triangle present (gross) and used for cross-checking.
